spans.s:
mfn. (-पिः-पिः-पि)
Who or what drinks.
m. (-पिः)
The moon.
E.
पा to drink, कि aff. and the root repeated.

m. (-पिः)
1 The moon.
2 The sun.
E.
पा to drink, reiterated by special rule, Uṇādi aff. इस्.

f. (-तिः)
Mutual or reciprocal drinking, drinking alike or together.
E.
पा to drink, in the reiterative form, aff. क्तिन्.

m. (-पुः)
A fosterer, a protector.
f. (-पुः)
A nurse, a fostermother.
E.
पा to cherish, कु aff. and the radical consonant repeated.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
1 Mischievous, destructive, malignant.
2 Vile, low, abandoned, vicious.
m. (-पः)
A wicked man, a wretch, a profligate.
n. (-पं)
Sin, crime, wickedness, vice.
E.
पा to preserve (from it), and प Uṇādi aff.

n. (-कं)
Sin.
E.
कन् added to the last.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Wicked, abandoned.
E.
पाप, and कर who does.

mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्ती-र्त्तृ)
Sinful, wicked, a sinner.
E.
पाप, and कर्त्तृ who does.

mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म)
Wicked, sinful.
E.
पाप, and कर्म्मन् act.

mfn. (-कृत्)
Sinful, wicked, a sinner.
E.
पाप sin, कृ to commit, aff. क्विप्.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Evidently involved in the consequences of sin.
E.
पाप, and गोचर visible object.

m. (-हः)
Any ill omened aspect of the stars, as the conjunction of the sun or Budha with the moon in its last quarter.
2

Rāhu.
3

Saturn.
4

Mars.
E.
पाप, and ग्रह asterism.

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं)
Removing sin.
E.
पाप, and घ्न destructive.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Who or what matures or cooks often or much.
E.
पच to cook, &c. frequent. v., ण्वुल् aff.; also पापाचक.

m. (-र्य्यः)
1 A sinner.
2 A fiend, a Rākṣasa.
E.
पाप, and चर्य्या practice, or चर्य्य to be gone (in or by.)

mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः)
Wicked, vile.
E.
पाप, and चेतस् understanding.

f. (-ली)
A plant, commonly Aknidhi, (Cissampelos hexandra.)
E.
पच to ripen, reiterated पापच, (rheumatism,) ईर to dissipate, affs. अच् and ङीप्, and र changed to ल; also with कन् added in the fem. form पापचेलिका.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Who or what alights, goes or falls much or frequently.
E.
पत to alight, &c. frequent. v, किन् aff.

mfn. (-र्शी-र्शिनी-र्शि)
Malevolent, looking at faults.
E.
पाप, and दर्शिन् who sees.

mfn. (-श्वा-श्वा-श्व)
Conscious of guilt, knowing an act to be wicked.
E.
पाप, and दृश to see, क्वनिप् aff.

m. (-तः)
A vile or bad barber.
E.
पाप sinful, नापित a barber.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
Purifying, sin-destroying.
E.
पाप, and नाशिन् destroying.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Wicked, villainous, a wretch.
f. (-तिः)
Wickedness.
E.
पाप, and निरति attachment.

m. (-तिः)
A paramour, a gallant.
E.
पाप wicked, and पति husband.

m. (-षः)
A personification of all sin, or a male, whose head is Brahmanicide, whose arms are theft, whose heart is wine drinking, &c.
E.
पाप, and पुरुष a man.

mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि)
Evil-minded, wicked.
E.
पाप, and बुद्धि intellect.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Of a corrupt mind, depraved.
E.
पाप, and मति mind.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Freed from sin, liberated from all crime.
E.
पाप, and मुक्त set free.

f. (-निः)
Birth in some inferior state, as an animal, &c. as the punishment of sin.
E.
पाप, and योनि womb.

m. (-गः)
A disease, considered as the punishment of sin in a former life.
2 Small pox.
E.
पाप sin, and रोग disease.

f. (-र्द्धिः)
Hunting, chase.
E.
पाप sin, and ऋद्वि thriving.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Giving or taking sin.
n. (-लं)
A measure.
E.
पाप, and लच् aff.

m. (-हः)
Restraining or punishing wickedness.
E.
पाप, and विनिग्रह restraint.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Palliating or removing crime.
n. (-नं)
A sin-offering.
E.
पाप, and शमन appeasing.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Equal in sin, of like guilt.
E.
पाप, and सम्मित measured.

m. (-त्मा)
A sinner, a reprobate, a wretch.
E.
पाप, and आत्मन् soul.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Addicted to sin.
E.
पाप, and अनुवसित dwelling with.

f. (-त्तिः)
Expiation.
E.
पाप, and अपनुत्ति removing.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Wicked, sinful.
E.
पाप, and आशय abode.

mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि)
Wicked, sinful, bad, a sinner.
E.
पाप, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Very wicked.
E.
पाप, and इष्ठन् aff.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
Very wicked.
E.
पाप, and ईयसुन् aff.

m. (-प्मा)
Sin, wickedness.
E.
पा to preserve (from it), मनिन् Uṇādi aff., deriv. irr.
